Binary Merkle tree hashing, commit, proof, and verification functions based on SHA-256.

# Purpose
This file implements a binary Merkle tree library that uses SHA-256 as the hash function. It is written as a template source file that can be included with different macro settings to build tree variants with different hash widths, such as the 20-byte and 32-byte forms used in the Solana protocol. The file defines the public node type, leaf hashing, tree depth and node count helpers, and the commit API used to build a tree from leaf nodes and return the root hash.

The code also provides proof handling and proof-based state updates. Functions such as [`fd_bmtree_get_proof`](<#fd_bmtree_get_proof>), [`fd_bmtree_from_proof`](<#fd_bmtree_from_proof>), [`fd_bmtree_commitp_insert_with_proof`](<#fd_bmtree_commitp_insert_with_proof>), and [`fd_bmtree_commitp_fini`](<#fd_bmtree_commitp_fini>) manage inclusion proofs, rebuild roots from proofs, and maintain cached tree nodes and proof validity state. The implementation includes an AVX path in [`fd_bmtree_private_merge`](<#fd_bmtree_private_merge>) for faster hashing on supported x86 systems, and it uses a small set helper from `fd_smallset.c` to track which proof entries are valid.
